summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing completed for GRC platform. 21/21 pytest backend tests passed (auth, tenants, dashboard, reviews CRUD, generic entities GET/POST for findings/risks/policies/vendors/assets/tasks, evidence upload/list/download/delete, comments, audit-logs, tenant isolation, readonly role enforcement). Frontend Playwright E2E passed: login as super_admin succeeds and redirects to Dashboard with all 4 KPI cards (kpi-overdue, kpi-open-findings, kpi-critical, kpi-risks). Org selector shows both tenants (Acme, Globex). All sidebar nav items (nav-reviews, nav-findings, nav-risks, nav-policies, nav-vendors, nav-assets, nav-tasks, nav-evidence, nav-audit) route correctly. Reviews list renders rows, search+status filter present, row click opens drawer with Overview/Comments/Activity tabs. create-reviews-button opens a new-record drawer with field-title/field-review_type/field-status/field-due_date/field-recurrence and drawer-save creates the record. Evidence dropzone accepts file via evidence-file-input; row and download testid render. Audit log row-0 renders after actions.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in RecordListPage render. Likely the schema.columns map (rendered in both thead and tbody) or the schema.fields dropdown — inspect key= usage. Cosmetic but should be fixed.

action_items: Fix React 'unique key' warning in RecordListPage (add stable key on the mapped elements, likely in the columns/fields mapping).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 797-line file. Consider splitting auth, entities, and seed into modules for maintainability (>700 line threshold).

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False; frontend uses Bearer token so this is fine, but Set-Cookie headers (SameSite=None; Secure) are effectively unusable from the SPA. Comment/document this in server.py to prevent confusion.
Generic entity POST accepts body as Dict[str, Any] and validates via Pydantic manually — fine, but 422 vs 400 error semantics could be improved. Consider Body(...) typing.
Dashboard 'significant_risks' only counts impact=='high' (not 'critical'). If likelihood/impact score has a critical bucket in future, will miss.
No rate-limit / brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends lockout after N attempts). Not required by MVP but worth noting.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md — used robbashea@gmail.com/Admin@2026 (super_admin) and Demo@2026 for demo users
seed_data_creation: None new. Backend auto-seeds Acme Corp / Globex Ltd tenants + demo users + reviews/findings/risks/policies/vendors/assets/tasks on startup (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified via pytest in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse as regression suite. Frontend E2E covered dashboard, org selector, all nav, reviews CRUD drawer, evidence upload, audit log. Only cosmetic React 'unique key' warning noted in RecordListPage.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues found. React key warning RCA: likely a schema.columns or field render mapping missing key= prop; check /app/frontend/src/pages/RecordListPage.jsx map calls and RecordDrawer field render.
